name: model-advisor
description: Suggests a cheaper model when your prompt is simple, and a stronger one when it is hard.

useModel.title: Ask a small model too
useModel.description: Also rate each prompt with one tiny completion on the classifier model (a few tokens per prompt). Off: local word and length rules only.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: The model alias or id that rates prompts when 'Ask a small model too' is on.

display.title: Show suggestions as
display.description: A band above the prompt, a toast, or both.
